summary.text: Tim Melson, a Republican, has represented District 1 in the Alabama State Senate since November 2014 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Alabama and an M.D. from the University of Alabama at Birmingham.
His professional experience includes serving as chief of anesthesia at Helen Keller Hospital.
